input: s is an ASCII lowercase string of length at most 4000; empty input is accepted with result zero. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. Python integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool.
return: Maximum operations deleting all characters, where an operation deletes the whole remaining string or deletes its first L characters when they equal the immediately following L characters.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Exact Z lengths test adjacent repeated prefixes, not repeated text elsewhere. DP entries are at most the remaining suffix length, and all indices/counts are small exact integers. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n^2+1) time and O(n+1) live auxiliary space: one DP row plus a constant number of suffix strings/Z arrays during replacement. Full suffix copying, every Z pass and every candidate deletion are charged; no hidden quadratic matrix. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.

helpers.name: z_values
helpers.contract: For each index>0 returns the common-prefix length between text and its suffix there; index zero is unused and remains zero. The maintained matching interval is half-open [left,right).
helpers.cost: O(L+1) time/O(L+1) output space per length-L suffix; each extension advances the right boundary, with standard Z-box reuse. Entire helper charged. Its complete definition is 489 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines count toward total source bytes.

source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 934 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.

Input/effect/complexity declarations are not frozen-predecessor equivalence receipts. No candidate execution/import, behavioral qualification, benchmark acceptance or M1/M2 pass is claimed.
